note: Full text not stored due to copyright. Read PDF pp. 71-86 on-the-fly for Phase 2 analysis. Michalski is the GA 18 editor; this essay carries authoritative weight on Heidegger's philological method. Footnote 1 of the chapter notes establishes the GA 18 'Henceforth' convention. The essay's titular argument — that hermeneutic phenomenology IS philology for Heidegger in 1924 — is methodologically constraining for the entire volume.
